name: epistemic-record-format
description: The Epistemic Record Format: specification, reference validator and viewer, conformance suite.

scripts.postinstall: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && npm install --prefix validator/yaml-markdown/typescript && npm install --prefix tools/viewer && npm install --prefix conformance && npm install --prefix tools/mcp-server
scripts.test: npm test --prefix conformance && npm test --prefix tools/mcp-server
